stemBlocks: Two objects of mass $M$ and $m$ are connected by a rope over a pulley on an inclined plane as shown.

There is no friction between the plane and the object. The pulley is smooth, and the rope has negligible mass.
The angle $\theta$ of the plane to the horizontal is such that $\sin \theta = 0.80$ and $\cos \theta = 0.60$.
The object with mass $M$ accelerates down the slope.
Which expression describes the full range of possible values of $M$ compared with $m$?
